# How We'll Build It

#### Course: Canvas Foundations

## How We'll Build It

To build Brick Breaker, you will learn each piece one at a time.

Here is what this course covers:

- A coordinate system for positioning every object on screen
- Rectangles for the paddle and bricks
- A circle for the ball
- Text that displays the score
- A smooth animation loop that updates the screen many times per second
- Mouse and keyboard input so the player can control the paddle
- Collision detection so the ball bounces and breaks bricks

![Brick Breaker game wireframe showing paddle, ball, and brick grid](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Nothing in this course is filler.

Every chapter teaches one of those pieces. By the end, they all come together into a real working game.

Next, let's quickly check what you need to know before we start building.
